Initiative_Tracker.Name: West Oakland Stabilization Fund
Initiative_Tracker.Notes: Cycle 78: Passed 6-3. Ramon Vega voted yes. Leonard Tran voted no. (Elliott Crane voted yes remotely)
Initiative_Tracker.MilestoneNotes:
C107: Downtown canvass deployment authorized alongside month-eight disbursement review.
C108 conversion: passed C78 before the mayoral-action step existed; the mayor's own bill, recorded signed at C78.
C108 conversion: Stage Standing — Stabilization Fund, disbursement-active since C78 (economic — not playable, no Delivering gate yet; the untended clock still runs). | C108 retag economic→housing (ruled 2026-09-22 — the Fund is a household anti-displacement fund in canon; engine.255 wires it as the first budgeted disbursement).
C108: scope recorded as chartered — stabilization grants for long-tenure West Oakland residents priced out as the flats built out (the remnant the charter named), not hood-wide relief; 47 checks (~$4.2M) disbursed under Deputy Mayor Okoro’s authority C84–C90; authorization $28M, ~$23.8M remaining.
C108: retag reversed — housing→economic (the 2026-09-22 retag was engine-sheet error; the Fund is not a housing fund).
C109 scope correction: the Fund serves West Oakland businesses and residents. The C107 'Downtown canvass' line and the C108 'residents only' reading are superseded.
C109: month-eight tranche $400,000 released in West Oakland (2 household grants, $81,188). Downtown is outside the Fund's area — that is INIT-008, proposed, not voted.
C110: Month-nine disbursement $400K approved; 23-day avg processing time achieved
